Authored V04 regressions cover provider-head advance, signer snapshot mismatch, epoch mismatch, and fingerprint mismatch. Exact-current executable workflow evidence is not visible, so the evidence gap is not released and no PASS is claimed.

The final re-entry stale-root/trust-snapshot/key-provenance defect is materially repaired in V04 source/tests, but production provider/key custody and exact-current executable evidence remain TEST_REQUIRED. This repair does not close moving-provider-head recovery liveness.

MOVING_PROVIDER_HEAD_RECOVERY_MUST_NOT_STARVE_GOAL_CONTINUITY remains open. V04 correctly rejects a stale root when provider head advances, but current V04 contains no authenticated bounded fresh-root re-establishment loop that reacquires fresh Mission authority/current provider head, constructs a new root, and demonstrates eventual non-terminal re-entry after benign provider-head churn. Provider churn, root invalidation, retry, backoff, recovery duration and re-establishment counters must remain operational-only with zero Experience/appraisal/drive/exploration/preference/personality/P_base/trauma/relief effect.

Authenticated terminal-exit is not the next closure while 047 remains open. V04 stops at CLOCK_EPOCH_REENTERED_SHADOW with routing_authority_allowed=false, so stale secretary pressure, prior terminal hold, anti-thrash age, provider/retry state and stale goal-continuity cache exclusion across terminal exit is still unproven.
The 10000 authenticated signed-pressure A/B chronicity neutrality experiment remains independently required. A different tranche PASS must not release it.

Static/dynamic end-to-end exclusion remains required for provider, signer, trust snapshot, key fingerprint, epoch, receipt, checkpoint, signature, root invalidation, retry, recovery and secretary-pressure metadata into Experience/appraisal/drive/exploration/preference/personality/P_base/trauma/relief sinks.
Synthetic provider/key fingerprint behavior is not production HSM/TPM/remote-provider independence, durability, rotation, loss or revocation proof.
No valid matched-workload paired baseline/current speed evidence establishes a multiplier. Maintenance, recovery, poll, retry, workflow count and elapsed waiting are forbidden proxies.

Current lcr-quantum-gearbox-clock-epoch-shadow.yml explicitly imports, compiles and runs V01, V03 and exact-current V04 regressions and emits bounded evidence. Workflow plumbing exists, but run visibility is EVIDENCE_VISIBILITY_GAP; workflow existence alone is not executable PASS.
